columns.name: permissions

columns.name: row_data
columns.check: jsonb_typeof(row_data) = 'object'::text AND row_data ?& ARRAY['SI'::text, 'Buyer/Team'::text, 'EWO'::text, 'Line No'::text, 'PSD'::text, 'PCD'::text, 'Sewing Trims Pending Stts'::text, 'Finishing Trims Pending stts'::text, 'Carton Receiving Stts'::text, 'Inventory Status'::text, 'Inspection Status'::text, 'Trims Card status'::text, 'Final Status'::text, 'Relavant Concern '::text, 'Relevant M&M Name'::text]

constraints.name: plan_daily_record_id_fkey

constraints.name: plan_daily_upload_id_fkey
